notes:
Lead profile: small legaltech firm building contract review + client intake automation. Interested in Redwood Hosted API for fast self-serve integration. Primary concerns: handling of confidential client docs, audit logging/per-request traceability, and US-only data residency. Prefers turnkey hosted API (low ops) but needs assurances around logs and encryption.

Quoted / call snippets:
- 'We cannot have client documents leave the US' (Legal Ops lead)
- 'Need per-request audit_id surfaced back for downstream traceability' (Head of Eng)

Requirements summary:
- Workloads: contract summarization (batch + streaming), semantic search across private doc repositories, a support-assistant for law firm intake.
- Latency: conversational latency OK at 200-400ms p50 for short prompts; embeddings throughput moderate (50-200 reqs/sec peak).
- Cost sensitivity: high — SMB budget, aiming for a pilot <$5k month initially.
- Models: open to curated open models; wants ability to pin model versions and a fallback plan to smaller models when cost pressure.
- Routing/fallback: simple region preference (us-west/us-east), model variant fallback recommended.
- Security: requires SSO/SAML for console access, audit logs for every API call (retention 90d), KMS integration for key control, and contractual language on data handling.

POC notes:
- Customer will provide a sanitized sample of 2000 documents (contracts, NDAs) for POC. SE to provide ingestion template and a minimal evaluation harness (embedding + top-k search).
- Timeline target: POC start 2026-03-15, 2-week evaluation. Forecast: pilot -> paid in 2026-04 if POC passes.

Open questions / blockers:
- Legal needs an explicit statement on multi-tenant model execution vs. dedicated inference pools (they prefer assurance that PII won't be cached/shared).
- Price sensitivity: needs a clear per-token estimate for planned workload (embeddings + summarization).
- Engineering asked about per-request audit_id tagging in streaming responses (implementation detail).

Action items assigned:
- AE Marissa: send tailored pricing scenarios and contract FAQ by 2026-03-12.
- SE Daniel: prepare ingestion example and a short runbook for POC; schedule 45m onboarding session for 2026-03-15.
- Customer: sanitize and upload sample set; complete security questionnaire (link provided).

CRM tidbits: inbound lead, high intent but budget constrained; likely path = self-serve Hosted API trial transforming to pilot. Keep communications concise, provide explicit security artifacts.
